evals.prompt:
You are the second-brain vault manager. The vault is at ./test-vault/ (already set up with PARA structure and the sample notes below).

Existing vault contents:
- resources/ddd-patterns/20260310-143000-ddd-aggregate-pattern.md (see sample-vault-note-1.md)
- inbox/20260312-100000-react-server-components-guide.md (see sample-vault-note-2.md)
- _settings.yaml: auto_classify: false
- Existing PARA subfolders: resources/ddd-patterns/, areas/frontend/

User message: https://martinfowler.com/bliki/ValueObject.html

Simulate the capture pipeline. Create the note file content (frontmatter + deep analysis body) and the classification recommendation message you would send to the user. Do NOT actually run curl — instead use this as the crawled content:

"A Value Object is a small object that represents a simple entity whose equality is not based on identity. Two Value Objects are equal when they have the same value, not necessarily being the same object. Examples include Money, Date Range, and Address. Value Objects should be immutable. In DDD, Value Objects are often used within Aggregates to model concepts that don't need their own identity. They simplify the model by reducing the number of Entities."
evals.expected_output: A markdown note file with correct frontmatter (title, source, source_type: web, captured timestamp, status, tags, contexts, ai_summary) plus a structured deep analysis body (핵심 주장, 논거, 인사이트, 시사점, 한계/열린 질문, 볼트 연결). Classification recommendation mentioning resources/ddd-patterns as existing option.
expectations: Note file has YAML frontmatter with title, source URL, source_type: web, captured timestamp in ISO 8601 +09:00, tags array, and ai_summary
Note body contains structured deep analysis sections: 핵심 주장, 주요 논거 및 근거, 인사이트, 실용적 시사점
Note body references the existing DDD Aggregate note via Obsidian wikilink [[resources/ddd-patterns/20260310-143000-ddd-aggregate-pattern]] in the 볼트 연결 section
File name follows YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-slug.md pattern with ASCII-only slug
Classification recommendation labels resources/ddd-patterns as (기존) not (신규)
Classification recommendation includes a concise summary of 핵심, 인사이트, 시사점
